race.description: Kelley Racing & Cooma Monaro Legal Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ON THE FLY (2) is knocking on the door of a maiden win, finishing a half-length away last start when seemingly getting every chance. The winner was too good there, but this shapes similarly with the winkers on now. Can land the knockout blow this time. AQUILINO (5) poses a significant threat after running second at Goulburn and third here. Had his chance to knock one over, but he's among friends here and his recent efforts stand up. BETTER BLOOM (6) returns from a break after finishing last at Canberra, beaten by just under four lengths, but her third at Moruya two starts ago keeps her competitive if in form. TOP PICK (4) is building nicely this campaign and has a nice fitness base now. Draws to feature if good enough.
